objective: Measure native MLX, mixed precision and microbatch utilization on the existing M4 Mac without changing the foundation learning problem.

reference.data: Use unchanged prepared native TinyStories token shards and tokenizer. No corpus downloads or retokenization.

implementation.model: Pinned Apple MLX-LM Llama layers, with exact existing architecture and explicit checkpoint-key mapping.
implementation.attention: Native optimized causal attention; no custom Metal kernel development in this budget.
implementation.compilation: Compile stable-shape gradient/accumulation/update functions. Explicitly evaluate/synchronize at measurement boundaries; no timing lazy graph construction as executed training.
implementation.precision: Mixed variants use BF16 or FP16 matrix operations and activations; FP32 master weights, optimizer moments, gradient accumulation, norm and loss reductions. FP16 uses recorded bounded loss scaling; no low-precision-only optimizer updates.
implementation.optimizer: Preserve original AdamW parameter groups, betas, epsilon, clipping and schedule. Explicitly enable MLX AdamW bias_correction=True; its default is False.
implementation.rope: Preserve adjacent-pair rotary convention with rope_traditional=True, theta=10000, head_dim=48.
implementation.logging: Read loss on update boundaries; bounded input prefetch; retain stop checks without scalar GPU synchronization on every microbatch.

numerical_acceptance_proposed_engineerin.scope: Frozen training batches and development text only; no final-test-based tuning.

required: Per-arm compilation/startup time, completed optimizer updates and executed training positions
Correctness and mixed-precision acceptance results; rejected arms remain visible
One-hour winner measurement; final30-minute wall-clock tokens/sec, including intervening input and checkpoint overhead
